final_message:
Done — all 29 tests pass (`SMS_GATEWAY_TOKEN=env-tok python -m pytest -q`; the last client test reads that variable from the real environment).

Implementation summary:

- **`smsgate/segments.py`** — `detect_encoding` returns `gsm7` only if every char is in the provided alphabets. `plan_segments` computes per-char unit costs (extended 7-bit chars cost 2; non-BMP chars cost 2 UTF-16 units), keeps texts ≤160/≤70 units as one part, otherwise greedily fills parts to 153/67 units, never splitting a character, and raises `ValueError` on empty text.
- **`smsgate/numbers.py`** — strips spaces/dots/hyphens/parentheses, maps `00`→`+`, single `0`→`+`+`default_cc`, keeps `+`, then validates against `^\+[1-9]\d{7,14}$`, raising `ValueError` otherwise.
- **`smsgate/client.py`** — `SmsClient` strips the token (blank → `MissingTokenError`), `from_env` reads `SMS_GATEWAY_TOKEN`, `build_request` normalizes/segments first (so `ValueError`s precede any network I/O) and POSTs JSON to `{base_url}/messages` with `Authorization: Token …`, and `send` wraps `urlopen`/JSON-decode failures (`URLError`, `OSError`, `JSONDecodeError`) in `GatewayError`.
